function.name: modify_sap_object
function.description: CHANGE THE ACTUAL SOURCE CODE of an EXISTING SAP object - the source on disk will be rewritten and saved. Use this tool ONLY when the user explicitly wants to alter the code: add, change, refactor, fix, rewrite, or DELETE something INSIDE an object (a FORM/subroutine, a method, a block of code, header comments, lines, a variable). 'delete/remove/clear the form X', 'remove the comments', 'delete method M', 'add a parameter', 'rename X', 'fix the bug' are modifications handled here (NOT delete_sap_object, which erases the whole program/class). DO NOT USE THIS TOOL when the user only wants information ABOUT the code and no change to it: requests to describe, explain, document, list, summarise, analyse, review the code, write a description of methods, produce a table/instruction/overview - those are READ-ONLY: call read_sap_object and answer in text, never modify_sap_object. Rule of thumb: if after the request the source code should stay byte-for-byte identical, this is NOT a modification. The object must have been read with read_sap_object first. The result is wrapped in a <code_modified> envelope and saved after user confirmation. Do NOT use for examples the user does not want saved - use show_code_example instead.

object_type.description: Type of SAP object to modify. For method signature changes use CLAS, not METH.

object_name.description: Technical name, e.g. 'ZCL_TEST'. For signature changes the class name only, not CLASS=>METHOD.

action_description.description: Precise description of the change to perform
